section.title: Enhance
section.hint: Make this clip's video look better. Your original stays in your project.
section.pick: What do you want to do?
section.noChoice: Pick one to see what it would cost.
section.planHeight: Your plan goes up to {height}p. Upgrade to pick this.
section.aiLimit: AI slow motion goes up to 4x.
section.needsPicture: Enhance works on a video clip on a picture track.

choiceHint.upscale: Makes the picture bigger and crisper.
choiceHint.interpolate: Adds in-between frames so slow motion looks smooth.
choiceHint.denoise: Takes out grain and speckle from dark or low-light shots.
choiceHint.motionBlur: Adds a natural blur to fast movement.
choiceHint.extend: Adds picture around the clip so it fills a different shape.

sides.hint: Pick the sides that get new picture. They all grow by the same amount.
sides.required: Add some picture on at least one side.

prompt.label: What should the new edges show? (optional)
prompt.description: Plain words, up to {max} characters. Leave blank to continue the scene naturally.

estimate.line: {cost}. The new video is {width} by {height} at {fps} frames a second, about {size} MB, and takes about {time}.

cancelled: Stopped. Nothing changed in your timeline.
done: Ready. Compare, then apply it to your clip.
applied: Applied to your clip. One undo puts it back.

needsOk.title: Ready - needs your OK
needsOk.body: The clip you enhanced is no longer in your timeline. The new video is saved in your media.

consent.title: Send this video to an outside service?
consent.body: AI enhancement sends this video's picture to an outside video service to process it. It is used for this project only. Fast never sends anything.
consent.check: I agree to send this project's videos to an outside service for AI enhancement
consent.failed: We could not save your choice. Try again.

refusal.credits: You need {missing} more credits for this.
refusal.creditsPlain: You do not have enough credits for this.
refusal.plan: Your plan does not include this. See the plans to unlock it.
refusal.planVideo: Your plan does not include video enhancement. See the plans to unlock it.
refusal.planResolution: Your plan does not go up to this size. Pick a smaller size or see the plans.
refusal.consent: Agree to send the video to an outside service first.
refusal.tooLong: This video is too long to enhance.
refusal.tooLongMax: This video is too long. The longest we can enhance is {seconds} seconds.
refusal.tooShort: This video is too short to extend. Use a longer clip.
refusal.tooShortMin: This video is too short to extend. Use a clip of at least {seconds} seconds.
refusal.busy: You have a lot running right now. Wait a moment and try again.
refusal.unavailable: This is not available right now. Try Fast, or try again later.
refusal.notFound: We could not find this video in your project.
refusal.other: That did not work. Try again.
refusal.notMeasured: We could not measure this video yet. Try again in a moment.
refusal.email: Verify your email address first, then try again.
refusal.invalid: That choice is not allowed for this video. Pick another option.

failure.ENHANCE_DURATION_MISMATCH: The new video came out a different length, so we did not use it. Your credits were refunded. Try again.
failure.timeout: This took too long and was stopped. Try again.
failure.failed: That did not work. Nothing changed in your timeline. Try again.
failure.ENHANCE_SOURCE_CHANGED: The picture changed while it was being enhanced, so we did not use the result. Your credits were refunded. Try again.
failure.tooLong: This video is too long to enhance.
failure.tooShort: This video is too short to extend. Use a longer clip.
failure.submitUnknown: We could not confirm that this started. It may still have been created, and any credits stay held until it is settled. Check your files before you try again.
failure.contentBlocked: The text for the new edges could not be used. Change it and try again.
failure.configInvalid: That extension is not possible for this video: it already has that shape, or a side would need to grow by more than half. Pick another one.
failure.noVideo: There is no picture in this file to enhance.
failure.outputTooLarge: The new video would be too large. Pick a smaller size.
failure.fpsTooHigh: The new video would have too many frames a second. Pick a smaller multiplier.
failure.notLarger: This video is already that size or bigger. Pick a larger size.
failure.invalid: That choice is not allowed for this video. Pick another option.
failure.processing: We could not process this video. Try another clip.
failure.service: The AI service is not available right now. Try Fast, or try again later.
failure.stillRunning: This is still running. Wait for it to finish.
failure.outputUnavailable: The new video could not be saved. Try again.

pool.title: Enhance {name}
pool.added: Done. The new video is in your media.
